truthfulness_boundary.apply_controls: Apply selected and Apply all safe prepare remediations only. Laravel creates persisted suggestions and PENDING approvals; the frontend explicitly states that WordPress is not mutated until explicit approval.
truthfulness_boundary.external_links: External links come from tenant-scoped persisted SyncedContent. Valid seo_canonical is preferred; otherwise a site URL plus persisted slug is used. No demo URL is synthesized.
truthfulness_boundary.navigation: Source absolute routes are adapted to tenant-qualified Laravel canonical routes and keep the active site context where required.
